decode_attention_shape_estimate.caveat: Multiply/add products inferred from tensor geometry; excludes projections, MUDD, normalization, softmax, masks, memory movement and call overhead. Not a runtime cost model.

interpretation: Each qualified decode still enters 12 four-layer group models plus embedding and head; component timing will show which calls dominate.

For a one-token decode at absolute position 32 or later, dynamic query preparation expands query rows to 32. The paired value-product source pads to 32 rows and computes all 16 two-row products before returning only the requested row.
That shape implies a large attention arithmetic workload per decode, but this static fact alone does not establish the observed bottleneck; component timings are required.
MIL op counts are graph-shape statistics. They do not predict Core ML CPU kernels, fusion, acceleration, memory traffic, or elapsed time.
scope: Read-only static source-package specs and source-code graph policy; no MLModel construction, native loading, compile, or inference.
